name: SkyWatch
description: Search satellite imagery archives from 50+ providers including Airbus, Vantor, and Planet directly from Claude. Browse available satellites and their specifications, estimate imagery pricing for any location worldwide, and discover data products across optical, SAR, and elevation categories. Filter results by cloud cover, resolution, date range, and provider. All results include direct links to SkyWatch Explore for viewing and ordering. No account or API key required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SkyWatch to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SkyWatch to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.skywatch.co/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SkyWatch MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SkyWatch provides these MCP tools: search_archive_imagery, calculate_pricing, get_satellites, and get_offerings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SkyWatch?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SkyWatch in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SkyWatch does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
SkyWatch is developed by SkyWatch Space Applications Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
